legend: Last year Bob earned by selling memory sticks. During each of n days of his work one of the two following events took place:
A customer came to Bob and asked to sell him a 2x MB memory stick. If Bob had such a stick, he sold it and got 2x berllars.
Bob won some programming competition and got a 2x MB memory stick as a prize. Bob could choose whether to present this memory stick to one of his friends, or keep it.

Bob never kept more than one memory stick, as he feared to mix up their capacities, and deceive a customer unintentionally. It is also known that for each memory stick capacity there was at most one customer, who wanted to buy that memory stick. Now, knowing all the customers' demands and all the prizes won at programming competitions during the last n days, Bob wants to know, how much money he could have earned, if he had acted optimally.
input: The first input line contains number n (1 ≤ n ≤ 5000) — amount of Bob's working days. The following n lines contain the description of the days. Line sell x stands for a day when a customer came to Bob to buy a 2x MB memory stick (0 ≤ x ≤ 2000). It's guaranteed that for each x there is not more than one line sell x. Line win x stands for a day when Bob won a 2x MB memory stick (0 ≤ x ≤ 2000).
output: Output the maximum possible earnings for Bob in berllars, that he would have had if he had known all the events beforehand. Don't forget, please, that Bob can't keep more than one memory stick at a time.

examples.input:
7
win 10
win 5
win 3
sell 5
sell 3
win 10
sell 10

legend.ai: 去年，Bob 靠出售内存条赚钱。在他工作的 n 天中，每天会发生以下两种事件之一：
一位顾客来到 Bob 这里，要求他卖给自己一根容量为 2x MB 的内存条。如果 Bob 有这样一根内存条，他就会将其卖出，并获得 2x 贝尔拉。
Bob 赢得了某项编程竞赛，并获得一根容量为 2x MB 的内存条作为奖品。Bob 可以选择将这根内存条送给他的一个朋友，也可以将其保留下来。
由于担心混淆内存条的容量并无意中欺骗顾客，Bob 从不保留超过一根内存条。已知对于每种内存条容量，最多只有一位顾客想要购买该容量的内存条。现在，在得知过去 n 天中所有顾客的需求以及在编程竞赛中赢得的所有奖品后，Bob 想知道，如果他采取最优策略，他最多可以赚到多少钱。

input.ai: 第一行输入包含整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 5000）——Bob 的工作日数量。接下来 n 行描述每一天的情况。形如 sell x 的行表示有顾客来找 Bob 买一个 2^x MB 的内存条（0 ≤ x ≤ 2000）。保证对每个 x，sell x 这样的行至多出现一次。形如 win x 的行表示 Bob 赢得一个 2^x MB 内存条的那一天（0 ≤ x ≤ 2000）。

output.ai: 如果 Bob 事先知道所有事件，输出他可获得的最高收入，单位为 berllar。请注意，Bob 一次不能持有超过一个内存条。
